CA.rationale: No attention/processing relation tying to identified content was present.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red positions), an explicit presentation/organization pattern and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same candidate referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Report explicitly names color content with explicit coordinate sets for a candidate referent.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status field is provided separately from the content coordinate sets.

O.rationale: The report states how the content is organized/represented (explicit coordinate groupings) for the candidate referent.
